findings.text: the section-4 landed block carries data-node="session-continuity-share-per-lane-day" where every sibling landed block carries data-section="sN" (in this plan at :149 and :191), so a reader selecting section-landed blocks by their section association misses section 4 silently; the data-node spelling belongs to the r-note data-reckon=landed blocks.

the reading's first line prints git rev-parse HEAD at run time, which was base 76e1bf93 while the code measured was the worktree's uncommitted velocity.py (its module line and the runner read reckon.velocity.session_continuity), so the header names a revision at which the metric does not exist and a later reader cannot resolve the reading to the code that produced it.
